summary: Nora's send cooldown and her per-conversation tag rate limit now survive a restart, so a redeploy no longer lets her speak twice in quick succession or answer the same tag twice.
details: The participation send cooldown is written down. It used to live only in the running process, so every container recreate reset it and Nora could speak uncalled again immediately afterwards however recently she had spoken.
The tag rate limit (one turn per conversation per interval) is written down too. A duplicate tag arriving just after a restart used to run a second turn.

A quiet window that had already been judged is no longer judged a second time after a restart: where the room was last evaluated is stored, and where the conversation has got to since is read back from the message record.
limitations: The count of messages accumulated toward the volume arm of a window still starts from zero after a restart, exactly as before. It is not stored, because writing it would put a database write on the per-message path the dispatcher must not wait on, and it cannot be re-derived from the message record without counting messages that were never participation candidates.
Nothing is backfilled: the first window and the first tag after this ships behave as they did before, and the cadence holds from there.
